rows.label: qst640201_msg0001
rows.name: Jenny, how's the shop doing?

rows.label: qst640201_msg0002
rows.name:
Yuuou-sama, we had another good day
today.

rows.label: qst640201_msg0003
rows.name:
A woman swept up by Neon Cookies, a
student buying up Snipe Puddings, a
child smiling over a Lovemerry Cake...

rows.label: qst640201_msg0004
rows.name:
It seems we've made all kinds of
people happy.

rows.label: qst640201_msg0005
rows.name: I'm glad to hear this.

rows.label: qst640201_msg0006
rows.name:
There is one thing I would like
to talk to you about, though.

rows.label: qst640201_msg0007
rows.name: Oh? What's that?

rows.label: qst640201_msg0008
rows.name:
The name UO Sweets is spreading not
just through Fons Maim, but all across
Alst.

rows.label: qst640201_msg0009
rows.name:
We're getting several inquiries from
other countries.

rows.label: qst640201_msg0010
rows.name:
They all ask us to deliver
Yuuou-sama's sweets.

rows.label: qst640201_msg0011
rows.name:
They say they'll pay shipping and
don't mind the higher price.

rows.label: qst640201_msg0012
rows.name: Hmmm...

rows.label: qst640201_msg0013
rows.name:
I'm grateful, but my sweets can't be
made to keep for long.

rows.label: qst640201_msg0014
rows.name:
It's far, but the only option is to
ask them to come all the way to this
shop...

rows.label: qst640201_msg0015
rows.name: Idaten...

rows.label: qst640201_msg0016
rows.name: You had an idea.

rows.label: qst640201_msg0017
rows.name: Let's have Idaten deliver the sweets.

rows.label: qst640201_msg0018
rows.name: I see. That's an excellent idea.

rows.label: qst640201_msg0019
rows.name: Idaten, could you come here?

rows.label: qst640201_msg0020
rows.name: P-po!

rows.label: qst640201_msg0021
rows.name:
I'd like you to deliver my sweets to
customers in other countries.

rows.label: qst640201_msg0022
rows.name:
Only your speed can get them there
while they're still delicious.

rows.label: qst640201_msg0023
rows.name: Can I count on you?

rows.label: qst640201_msg0024
rows.name: Of course, po!

rows.label: qst640201_msg0025
rows.name: Idaten will help everyone out, po!

rows.label: qst640201_msg0026
rows.name:
Jenny, could you give Idaten a
suitable delivery address right away?

rows.label: qst640201_msg0027
rows.name: Yes...

rows.label: qst640201_msg0028
rows.name:
Samuron-sama in Superbia wants ten
Lovemerry Cakes.

rows.label: qst640201_msg0029
rows.name: Understood, po!

rows.label: qst640201_msg0030
rows.name: I'm counting on you, Idaten.
